The frontier challenge is not sensor combination per se but the integration of sensor fusion with (a) explicit probabilistic uncertainty quantification — preserving and propagating the uncertainty inherent in the inference from observation to latent field state — and (b) an end-to-end coupling to a decision-support mechanism that uses that propagated uncertainty rather than discarding it at the decision interface.
